title: Sales & CS: Weekly enterprise ask prioritization cadence and executive briefing template
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable weekly prioritization cadence and a concise executive briefing template that Sales and Customer Success can use to surface enterprise feature requests (non-bug). Goal: reduce back-and-forth, standardize initial scoping, and produce an actionable weekly backlog slice for PM + Eng intake meetings.
intake_flow_steps: 1) Sales/CS submit request via shared form (Slack shortcut -> Intake form) with required fields (see initial_scope_fields)
2) Triage by Intake Coordinator within 48 hours: validate ask, ping customer for clarifications, flag security/regulatory concerns
3) Weekly Prioritization Block (30-45m): Sales/CS brief top 8 asks using briefing_template; PMs score with rubric; quick consensus on top 3 for scoping work
4) PMs create scoped PRD stub or engineering spike ticket (if needed) and assign to Eng triage board
5) Follow-up: CS notifies customer of expected timeline and next touchpoint; track in Customer Success tracker
scoring_rubric: Impact (0-5): revenue/retention/strategic – rate expected ARR uplift or retention risk mitigated
Effort (0-5): estimated person-weeks for a minimal shippable change (PM/Eng/Design)
Risk/Compliance (0-3): regulatory or security complexity; 0 = none, 3 = high
Breadth (0-3): number of customers or product surfaces affected
Strategic Fit (0-3): aligns to company priority areas (Dedicated/Private/Console/Optimize)
initial_scope_fields: Business Outcome / KPI they want to move:
Contact for technical discovery and escalation:
briefing_template:
Weekly Enterprise Ask Briefing (5-7 minutes per ask)

1) Ask summary (15-20s): customer, one-line request, why now
2) Business impact (30-45s): ARR or retention estimate, dependent deals or renewals, urgency 
3) Customer context (30s): usage patterns, current product gaps, any contractual commitments
4) Proposed scope (30-60s): minimal acceptance criteria and a possible MVP surface 
5) Estimated effort band (15s): small (<=2w), medium (2-6w), large (>6w) 
6) Risk flags (15s): security, data residency, compliance, custom billing, infra needs
7) Ask owner / next step (15s): who will own discovery and when PM will follow up

Notes: attach the intake form link and any Confluence stub; keep slides to one page. This template becomes the single source of truth for the weekly triage meeting.
acceptance_criteria: A templated intake + Slack shortcut is deployed and discoverable by Sales/CS
A weekly 30-45 minute prioritization meeting slot is established with clear roster
Briefing template is used for >=80% of asks presented in the first 4 weeks
Scoring rubric is applied and top-3 decisions are recorded as scoped follow-ups (PRD stub or spike ticket)
updates: 2025-02-12 — Aisha P: Drafted initial cadence and template after interviews with two AEs and one CS manager; they emphasized speed and clarity for exec briefings.
2025-02-14 — Marco R: Proposed triage owner rotation (Sales ops + CS lead) and Slack shortcut prototype; flagged potential overlap with existing intake form.
2025-02-16 — Leah Kim (Eng PM): Reviewed rubric and suggested adding 'Breadth' to capture multi-customer impact; requested an early engineering pulse on feasibility estimates.
2025-02-18 — Legal (note): Example asks may trigger data residency questions — suggested adding 'Region' to the intake form.
decisions: Use a lightweight scoring rubric (Impact/Effort/Risk/Breadth/Strategic Fit) to avoid long debates during the meeting
Limit weekly meeting to top 8 asks pre-filtered by Intake Coordinator; only 3 get scoped into PM/Eng work each week
Intake must include 'Known Constraints' to surface compliance flags earlier
blockers: Intake form ownership: Sales Ops needs a templated Slack shortcut and permissions to install (blocker until 2025-02-24)
No reliable canonical list of enterprise customers in CRM (makes Breadth scoring inconsistent)
next_steps: Deploy Slack shortcut + intake form (owner: Sales Ops) — target 2025-02-24
Run two pilot weekly triage meetings with pilot AEs/CS managers (owner: Marco R) — target weeks 2025-W08 and 2025-W09
Collect scoring data from pilots and calibrate thresholds for auto-escalation to PMs
Create PRD stub template and engineering spike ticket template to accelerate handoff
